title: Scaling Out Chip Interconnect Networks with Implicit Sequence Numbers
problem: Scaling chip interconnects (CXL, NVLink, UALink) to multi-node configurations requires reliable error handling at high transfer rates; existing mechanisms don't address silent flit drops
motivation: Enable robust, scalable multi-node interconnects without sacrificing bandwidth efficiency or compatibility
method: Implicit Sequence Number (ISN) mechanism for flit drop detection and in-order delivery; Reliability Extended Link (RXL) protocol extending CXL with ISN; layered error handling (CRC at transport, FEC at link)
key_novelty: ISN mechanism providing sequence integrity without header overhead; RXL protocol maintaining CXL compatibility while adding multi-node reliability
contributions: ISN mechanism for precise flit drop detection without header overhead
RXL protocol extending CXL for scalable multi-node interconnects
Layered reliability architecture (CRC transport + FEC link) maintaining bandwidth efficiency
limitations: Implementation details and performance evaluation not detailed in abstract; backward compatibility verification needed
primary_theme: Scalable and reliable chip interconnect networks
